productionCommit: Changes based on 2d105ce343bf16f385d0b8fdcca176dc397b2ede; exact pre-inference source bytes pinned below
datasetRole: Seen v4 regression, after development using first-pass errors and saved-output replay; not a new holdout.
provenance: Authored by the development assistant before inference, not collected from users or independently reviewed by an external evaluator. Chinese/English scenario families overlap, so the 240 inputs are not 240 statistically independent scenarios.
runtime: Windows JVM LiteRT-LM 0.10.2, CPU, JDK 21.0.7, Python 3.11.7, tzdata 2026.2
execution: Fresh generation for every non-preflight input with frozen production rules; same APK asynchronous Unicode-safe text transport on Windows JVM. One attempt and fresh conversation per input; no retries or manual output repair.

scoring.routing: Exact final response status and module; errors count as incorrect.
scoring.requiredFields: Micro average of annotated title/date fields plus finance amount/kind/category/account; null is correct only when annotated in advance. Optional memo deadline/priority and schedule time contribute to all-fields, not required-fields.
scoring.allSpecifiedFields: All annotated checks for one input must pass, including status/module. Titles use predeclared keyword alternatives, not full semantic equivalence.
scoring.supportedDraft: All checks pass on the 180 inputs expected to yield reviewable drafts. This does not measure UI entry or database writes.
scoring.rawModelRouting: Map raw single_task plus module to a draft, unclear/multiple_tasks to clarification, without production corrections. Denominator is only model-invoked cases, including failures; preflight-only outcomes are excluded.
scoring.limits: Money must use positive digit notation with at most two decimal places. Commas, written-number words, zero, negative and overprecision amounts stay unset for review. Memo past dates stay unset; calendar past dates remain. Missing/ambiguous fields stay unset. Quoted words are not temporal instructions. Unsupported mutations, queries, external actions and Health logging/control must clarify. Bare weekdays refer to the next occurrence (including today); this/next weekdays retain calendar-week semantics. Not-urgent alone leaves priority unset.

reporting: No latency statistics. Prior first-pass and seen-set regression artifacts remain unchanged. Android adapter/reliability checks are recorded separately.
